sentences.text: Longtime Doctor Who writer and showrunner Russell T Davies has criticised the new BBC director general over comments he made about an AI-generated episode of the show.
sentences.article_title: Russell T Davies criticises BBC boss's 'clumsy' AI Doctor Who comments

sentences.text: Matt Brittin told a Royal Television Society conference in September that he had been sent a "pretty good" 50-minute unofficial Doctor Who episode.
sentences.article_title: Russell T Davies criticises BBC boss's 'clumsy' AI Doctor Who comments

sentences.text: "That's a clumsy thing to say in an industry where he's got writers and artists and it specifically affects people, they're the first to take the blow," Davies told BBC Radio 4's The Media Show.
sentences.article_title: Russell T Davies criticises BBC boss's 'clumsy' AI Doctor Who comments

sentences.text: Addressing criticism he has received, Brittin told a staff meeting last week he was attempting to make a point around the "pace of change" while stressing he believed in "human creativity".
sentences.article_title: Russell T Davies criticises BBC boss's 'clumsy' AI Doctor Who comments

sentences.text: But speaking to BBC Radio 4, Davies said that the new director general, who joined the BBC after a career at Google, "hasn't worked in television for that long and might not be so fruity with an opinion in future".
sentences.article_title: Russell T Davies criticises BBC boss's 'clumsy' AI Doctor Who comments

sentences.text: "My inbox went ping ping ping ping ping, so God knows what his was like," he added.
sentences.article_title: Russell T Davies criticises BBC boss's 'clumsy' AI Doctor Who comments

sentences.text: Matt Brittin became the BBC's director general in May 2026 Davies was also asked more broadly about AI, including how, or if, writers should use the technology.
sentences.article_title: Russell T Davies criticises BBC boss's 'clumsy' AI Doctor Who comments

sentences.text: "I have heard stories of some writers using AI prompts to do a first draft which I find shocking because I think...
sentences.article_title: Russell T Davies criticises BBC boss's 'clumsy' AI Doctor Who comments

sentences.text: What are you paid for otherwise?
sentences.article_title: Russell T Davies criticises BBC boss's 'clumsy' AI Doctor Who comments

sentences.text: What are you there to do?" He said he did not use it to write his scripts but he "very much" worried it would start to replace writers, and in some circumstances that may already be the case.
sentences.article_title: Russell T Davies criticises BBC boss's 'clumsy' AI Doctor Who comments

sentences.text: Davies is one of the UK's most influential television writers - from the ground-breaking Queer as Folk to acclaimed dramas including It's a Sin, Years and Years and, more recently, Tip Toe, he has had a major impact on British TV.
sentences.article_title: Russell T Davies criticises BBC boss's 'clumsy' AI Doctor Who comments

sentences.text: But perhaps his most significant achievement is his work on Doctor Who.
sentences.article_title: Russell T Davies criticises BBC boss's 'clumsy' AI Doctor Who comments

sentences.text: In 2005, he brought the Timelord back after a 16-year absence after pitching it to the BBC's then-head of drama at a party in Manchester.
sentences.article_title: Russell T Davies criticises BBC boss's 'clumsy' AI Doctor Who comments

sentences.text: He revived the show again in 2023, although he confirmed earlier this year he would be stepping away.
sentences.article_title: Russell T Davies criticises BBC boss's 'clumsy' AI Doctor Who comments

sentences.text: He told The Media Show there were times he "used to dread going on a Doctor Who set" because of the expensive special effects and "explosions going on, people pulling themselves in to prosthetics".
sentences.article_title: Russell T Davies criticises BBC boss's 'clumsy' AI Doctor Who comments

sentences.text: "It's more difficult than any other set." The show is now at a crossroads.
sentences.article_title: Russell T Davies criticises BBC boss's 'clumsy' AI Doctor Who comments

sentences.text: The BBC cancelled the planned Christmas special and Disney+ no longer co-finances the series.
sentences.article_title: Russell T Davies criticises BBC boss's 'clumsy' AI Doctor Who comments

sentences.text: But Davies had good news for Doctor Who fans.
sentences.article_title: Russell T Davies criticises BBC boss's 'clumsy' AI Doctor Who comments

sentences.text: Another series is on the cards, he promised, even though he will not be involved.
sentences.article_title: Russell T Davies criticises BBC boss's 'clumsy' AI Doctor Who comments

sentences.text: "You'll start to see production with a brand-new Doctor, a brand-new companion, summer next year." Davies - who recently released his memoir 'The Queerest of Folk: A Life in Television' - got his first break aged 22 working in BBC children's TV "for £50 a day".
sentences.article_title: Russell T Davies criticises BBC boss's 'clumsy' AI Doctor Who comments

sentences.text: "It was the best training you could possibly have," he said.
sentences.article_title: Russell T Davies criticises BBC boss's 'clumsy' AI Doctor Who comments

sentences.text: The Swansea-born writer later honed his skills in the heyday of Granada Television "when Coronation Street was getting 18 million, 20 million [views]".
sentences.article_title: Russell T Davies criticises BBC boss's 'clumsy' AI Doctor Who comments

sentences.text: Also in the interview, he revealed inspiration can come from the most unlikely sources - he "records the phone-ins on This Morning" and listens to them in the evening.
sentences.article_title: Russell T Davies criticises BBC boss's 'clumsy' AI Doctor Who comments

sentences.text: "All human life is there… just a couple of times a year, you'll get an extraordinary human story or something very funny.
sentences.article_title: Russell T Davies criticises BBC boss's 'clumsy' AI Doctor Who comments

sentences.text: One of my favourite ones about a year ago was a woman whose mother-in-law was insisting on wearing white to her wedding".
sentences.article_title: Russell T Davies criticises BBC boss's 'clumsy' AI Doctor Who comments

sentences.text: TV presenter Davina McCall has said she experienced symptoms similar to "advanced Alzheimer's" following brain surgery.
sentences.article_title: Davina McCall says memory loss after brain surgery was like 'advanced Alzheimer's'

sentences.text: Speaking on Paloma Faith's podcast Mad, Sad and Bad, the 58-year-old described suffering from memory loss while recovering from an operation to remove a benign brain tumour in 2024.
sentences.article_title: Davina McCall says memory loss after brain surgery was like 'advanced Alzheimer's'

sentences.text: "After I'd had my brain tumour taken out, I had advanced Alzheimer's, so I couldn't remember anything," the former Big Brother host told singer and Celebrity Traitors star Faith.
sentences.article_title: Davina McCall says memory loss after brain surgery was like 'advanced Alzheimer's'

sentences.text: "When I came out of the operation, I didn't know I'd had an operation," she recalled.
sentences.article_title: Davina McCall says memory loss after brain surgery was like 'advanced Alzheimer's'

sentences.text: One regular member of staff would ask McCall every day if she could remember their name.
sentences.article_title: Davina McCall says memory loss after brain surgery was like 'advanced Alzheimer's'

sentences.text: "And I'd go, 'I don't know'." The Masked Singer judge had surgery in November 2024 after doctors had found a rare benign tumour, called a colloid cyst, in a health check-up as part of her menopause advocacy work.
sentences.article_title: Davina McCall says memory loss after brain surgery was like 'advanced Alzheimer's'

sentences.text: In November last year she revealed she had also undergone surgery for breast cancer.
sentences.article_title: Davina McCall says memory loss after brain surgery was like 'advanced Alzheimer's'

sentences.text: She called 2025 the "hardest year" for both her and her partner.
sentences.article_title: Davina McCall says memory loss after brain surgery was like 'advanced Alzheimer's'

sentences.text: Speaking about the recovery from her brain surgery, she said: "Michael would come and visit [the hospital] for two hours, and he'd go to the loo and come back, and I'd go, 'Oh my God, you're here', and I didn't know he'd been there.
sentences.article_title: Davina McCall says memory loss after brain surgery was like 'advanced Alzheimer's'

sentences.text: "I couldn't watch a movie for six months because I couldn't remember what had happened in the movie 15 minutes before. [When reading] a book I couldn't remember the page before." A year ago, for the first time since the brain surgery, she noted, she woke up and could remember what she had done the previous day.
sentences.article_title: Davina McCall says memory loss after brain surgery was like 'advanced Alzheimer's'

sentences.text: This video can not be played Watch: Davina McCall tears up on Comic Relief as she discusses brain surgery According to the NHS , external , later stage symptoms of Alzheimer's disease include "significant problems with short and long-term memory".
sentences.article_title: Davina McCall says memory loss after brain surgery was like 'advanced Alzheimer's'

sentences.text: Alzheimer's is a progressive disease and so symptoms gradually worsen over years.
sentences.article_title: Davina McCall says memory loss after brain surgery was like 'advanced Alzheimer's'

sentences.text: After brain surgery, though, problems tend to be worst early on, then stabilise and improve over weeks to months.
sentences.article_title: Davina McCall says memory loss after brain surgery was like 'advanced Alzheimer's'

sentences.text: Some people are left with milder lasting changes.
sentences.article_title: Davina McCall says memory loss after brain surgery was like 'advanced Alzheimer's'

sentences.text: Music therapy can help people to recover from brain injuries and McCall said she believes it was ultimately singing lessons that had "healed" her.
sentences.article_title: Davina McCall says memory loss after brain surgery was like 'advanced Alzheimer's'

sentences.text: In April last year, McCall revealed she had been told - following MRI scans - that her tumour was "not coming back".
sentences.article_title: Davina McCall says memory loss after brain surgery was like 'advanced Alzheimer's'

sentences.text: Benign tumours are not cancerous and they tend to grow slowly, according to the Brainstrust charity.
sentences.article_title: Davina McCall says memory loss after brain surgery was like 'advanced Alzheimer's'

sentences.text: Non-cancerous brain tumours are more common in people over the age of 50, and symptoms can include headaches, vision problems and drowsiness, the NHS says.
sentences.article_title: Davina McCall says memory loss after brain surgery was like 'advanced Alzheimer's'

sentences.text: McCall's surgery, known as a craniotomy, involved part of her skull being removed to take out the tumour.
sentences.article_title: Davina McCall says memory loss after brain surgery was like 'advanced Alzheimer's'

sentences.text: She has spoken publicly about the procedure and her recovery before, including on Comic Relief and on her own podcast called Begin Again.
sentences.article_title: Davina McCall says memory loss after brain surgery was like 'advanced Alzheimer's'

sentences.text: Danny Dyer led calls for nationalisation of the water industry on the River Thames on a float with a large poo sculpture on it Actor Danny Dyer has delivered a petition to Downing Street calling for water companies to be nationalised after floating a giant poo sculpture down the River Thames on a boat.
sentences.article_title: Danny Dyer in floating poo water protest on Thames

sentences.text: Dyer and Sittingbourne and Sheppey MP Kevin McKenna sailed along the Thames with the sculpture as part of a protest calling for the water industry to be brought into public ownership.
sentences.article_title: Danny Dyer in floating poo water protest on Thames

sentences.text: The actor, who runs a caravan park on the Isle of Sheppey with daughter Dani Dyer, delivered the petition having previously joined a local sewage protest in Leysdown in September .
sentences.article_title: Danny Dyer in floating poo water protest on Thames

sentences.text: A government spokesperson said it would "give the public more control and help keep bills as low as possible".
sentences.article_title: Danny Dyer in floating poo water protest on Thames

sentences.text: Nearly 350,000 people have signed the petition, started by campaigners SOS Whitstable.
sentences.article_title: Danny Dyer in floating poo water protest on Thames

sentences.text: Rivals actor Dyer and his daughter, who is currently competing on Strictly Come Dancing, joined the protest in September alongside singer Becky Hill, and Surfers Against Sewage.
sentences.article_title: Danny Dyer in floating poo water protest on Thames

sentences.text: He previously called the quality of bathing water "a disgrace", adding that issues with sewage discharges were "a very dangerous thing".
sentences.article_title: Danny Dyer in floating poo water protest on Thames

sentences.article_title: Danny Dyer in floating poo water protest on Thames

sentences.text: A government spokesperson said the prime minister had been "clear that the failures of the past must be corrected".
sentences.article_title: Danny Dyer in floating poo water protest on Thames

sentences.text: There have been no pollution incidents reported there, the website states.
sentences.article_title: Danny Dyer in floating poo water protest on Thames

sentences.text: "He has been meeting with a lot of local people who have shown him the scale of the problem.
sentences.article_title: Danny Dyer in floating poo water protest on Thames

sentences.text: "The vast majority of the public is really sick of it [sewage discharges] - they want it ended, I want it ended, and Danny wants it ended." A spokesperson for trade body Water UK said it was working to end sewage discharges "as fast as we possibly can".

sentences.text: A jury found Davis, 63, guilty in September of one count of murder with a deadly weapon for the rap superstar's death in a drive-by shooting in Las Vegas on 7 September 1996.

sentences.article_title: Ex-gang boss sentenced to 40 years for orchestrating Tupac Shakur's murder

sentences.text: He admitted in his memoir that he had provided the gun used in the crime.
sentences.article_title: Ex-gang boss sentenced to 40 years for orchestrating Tupac Shakur's murder

sentences.text: Davis' conviction was the first in a cold case that has intrigued hip-hop fans for nearly 30 years.
sentences.article_title: Ex-gang boss sentenced to 40 years for orchestrating Tupac Shakur's murder

sentences.text: Prosecutor Marc DiGiacomo argued during Tuesday's sentencing hearing that Davis spent years "publicly grandstanding" and bragging about his role on Shakur's death, which he said, "had wide-ranging effects upon the world".
